app.name: Quirewise
tools.noneRegistered: No tools are available in this build yet. You can still preview and inspect files.
options.title: Options
options.empty: Choose a tool to see its options.
drop.title: Drop PDFs or images here
drop.hint: Or press Ctrl+O to choose files. Files stay on this computer.
about.summary: Offline-first PDF toolkit for Windows x64 and arm64. No accounts, no uploads, no telemetry.
files.title: Files
queue.run: Run {tool} on {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
queue.noFiles: Add files to run a tool.
cancel.title: Cancel this job?
cancel.body: Files that are already finished are kept. The rest will not be processed.
result.title: Finished
inspect.title: Properties
inspect.imageSummary: {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}, {min, number} to {max, number} dpi
inspect.imagesSampled: Counted on the first {pages, number} pages.
inspect.pageSize: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} at {width, number} by {height, number} pt
inspect.locked: This file is password protected. Enter the password to see its properties.
password.title: Password needed
password.label: Password for {name}
password.wrong: That password is not correct. Check it and try again.
password.hint: The password is kept in memory for this session only.
suggest.title: Suggested
palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type a tool, file or action
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.escape: Close a dialog, or cancel a running job
recent.title: Recent files
recent.empty: Files you open appear here with a preview.
viewer.empty: Select a PDF to preview its pages.
viewer.imageFile: Images are previewed after they are converted to PDF.
settings.title: Settings
settings.recentHelp: Stored only on this computer. Clearing the list removes the previews from the home screen.
option.bookmark_per_file: Add a bookmark for each file
option.table_of_contents: Add a table of contents page
option.normalize_page_size: Scale all pages to the size of the first page
option.pages_per_turn: Pages from each file per turn
option.reverse.hint: Use for the back sides of a duplex scan.
option.ranges.hint: Each comma-separated part becomes one file, for example 1-3,4-6,7-.
option.merge_into_one: Put all ranges into one file
option.pages.hint: For example 1,3-5, even, odd, all or last.
option.extract-pages.pages.hint: The order you type is the order in the result.
option.one_file: Save all pages in one file
option.starts_with: Start a new file only when the text begins with
option.count: Pages to insert at each place
region.title: Text region
region.help: Draw a box around the text that tells the files apart, such as an invoice number. Or type the box in percent of the page.
region.needFile: Add a PDF to draw a region on its first pages.
region.numbers: Box in percent of the page
region.required: Draw a region to run this tool.
organize.title: Organize pages
organize.help: Select pages, then rotate, move, copy or delete them. Pages from every file in the list appear here. Drag pages to reorder, or use Alt with the arrow keys.
organize.count: {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}, {selected, number} selected
organize.empty: Add a PDF to organize its pages.
option.compress.preset.hint: Sets the image quality and resolution. The advanced options below replace it one by one.
option.jpeg_quality.hint: Leave empty to use the level above. Lower is smaller.
option.max_image_ppi.hint: Images with more pixels per inch than this are reduced.
option.strip_metadata: Remove the document information and XMP metadata
option.object_streams.hint: Smaller files. Very old viewers cannot read them.
option.linearize.enabled.hint: Off writes a normal copy that is not linearized.
option.remove-annotations.pages.hint: For example 1,3-5, even, odd or all.
choice.kinds.all: All except form fields and signatures
option.title: Title
option.author: Author
option.subject: Subject
option.creator: Created with
option.modification_date.hint: Same format as the creation date.
option.remove_all.hint: Clears the document information and the XMP packet. The other fields are ignored.
option.user_password.hint: Leave empty to let anyone open it.
option.owner_password.hint: Required when you turn off any permission below. It must differ from the opening password.
option.assemble: Insert, rotate, delete and reorder pages
option.form_actions: Actions of form fields and links
option.template.hint: Use {page}, {pages}, {date} and {filename}. Type {{ for a literal brace.
option.skip_first_page: Leave the first page without a number
option.skip_first_page.hint: The first page is not counted either.
option.facing_pages.hint: Mirrors the position on even pages, for double-sided printing.
option.digits.hint: The number is padded with zeros to this length.
option.continue_across_files: Keep counting from one file to the next
option.continue_across_files.hint: Follows the order of the file list.
option.apply_to_media_box: Also change the page size other programs see
option.preserve_page_size: Keep the size of the first page
option.preserve_page_size.hint: Off makes each sheet as large as the grid of full-size pages.
option.raster_fallback: Turn every page into a gray picture
option.raster_fallback.hint: Catches every color, but the text can no longer be selected.
option.auto_generate: Build from the large text of the document
option.bookmarks.hint: The list replaces the bookmarks of the file.
option.pattern.hint: Use {text} for the text read, plus {filename}, {date} and the other naming tokens.
option.names.hint: One name per line. Leave empty to extract all.
option.page-labels.ranges.hint: Pages before the first run are numbered 1, 2, 3.
region.crop.title: Area to keep
region.crop.help: Draw a box around what should stay on each page. Or type the box in percent of the page.
region.rename-by-content.title: Text to read
region.rename-by-content.help: Draw a box around the text that becomes the new name, such as an invoice number.
viewer.otherFile: This file is previewed after it is converted to PDF.
option.one_pdf: Put all pictures in one PDF
option.one_pdf.hint: Off makes one PDF for each picture.
option.images-to-pdf.page_size.hint: Fit makes each page as large as its picture.
option.pdf-to-images.dpi.hint: 75 for a screen, 150 for everyday use, 220 or more for print.
option.pdf-to-tiff.dpi.hint: 150 for everyday use, 300 or more for scans.
option.pdf-to-images.jpeg_quality.hint: Higher is sharper and makes a larger file.
option.single_tiff: Put all pages in one multi-page TIFF file
choice.compression.ccitt-g4: CCITT Group 4 (black and white pages, smallest)
option.keep_original_format: Keep the format of each picture
option.keep_original_format.hint: Off saves every picture as PNG.
choice.layout.layout: Keep columns and gaps in place
choice.encoding.utf8-bom: UTF-8 with a byte order mark
option.engine.hint: Automatic uses Microsoft Office when it is installed, otherwise LibreOffice.
option.slides.hint: Counted among the slides in the result.
option.sheets.hint: By position, for example 1,3. Choosing sheets of an old .xls file needs Microsoft Office.
option.fit_to_page_width: Fit every sheet to the page width
option.url.hint: Leave empty to print the files in the list. Needs permission to use the internet.
option.allow_network: Allow the page to load from the internet
option.allow_network.hint: Without it only pages on this computer print, and pictures or styles from the web are left out.
option.header_footer: Print the page title and number in the margins
option.load_timeout_s: Wait for the page at most (seconds)
components.title: Components
components.intro: Some tools need a program that is not part of Quirewise, such as LibreOffice for Office documents. Components are downloaded only after you agree, checked against a signature, and removed here at any time.
components.noneAvailable: No components are offered for this computer.
components.consent.title: Use the internet?
components.consent.check: Quirewise will contact the component server to see which components are available. Nothing else is sent.
components.consent.install: Quirewise will download {name} {version} ({mb, number} MB) and check it before installing.
component.libreoffice.use: Converts Word, PowerPoint and Excel files when Microsoft Office is not installed.
languages.none: No language is installed. Open Settings, then Components, to install one.
languages.hint: Choose every language the text uses. More languages are slower.
option.skip_pages_with_text: Skip pages that already have text
option.ocr.dpi.hint: 300 suits most pages. Small print may need 400 or 600.
option.angles.hint: Positive turns the page counter-clockwise, negative clockwise.
option.auto_crop: Cut away what is not paper
option.perspective_fix: Stand pages photographed at an angle upright
option.scan-to-pdf.dpi.hint: Sets the size of the pages. 300 suits most scans.
scan.title: Scan pages
scan.noScanner: No scanner was found. Connect one, or use the camera or files.
scan.help: Pictures are kept in Documents, Quirewise Scans. Each one is added to the list, ready for Scan to PDF.
scan.taken: {count, plural, one {# picture taken} other {# pictures taken}}
scan.cameraError: The camera could not be started. Check that it is connected and that Quirewise may use it.
component.tesseract.use: Reads scanned pages for OCR and Scan to PDF.
option.pdf-to-word.layout.hint: Flowing text is easiest to edit. Exact places every block where it was on the page.
choice.ocr.auto: Pages that are only a picture
choice.pdf-to-powerpoint.mode.editable-t: Text boxes, tables and pictures that can be edited
choice.pdf-to-powerpoint.mode.image-slid: One picture per slide (looks exact, cannot be edited)
option.pdf-to-powerpoint.dpi.hint: 150 suits a screen. Use 200 or more for print.
choice.pdf-to-excel.format.csv: CSV files, one for each sheet
option.detection.hint: Lines first, then aligned text, finds most tables. Use lines only to avoid false tables.
option.pdf-to-markdown.images: Save the pictures and link them
option.pdf-to-markdown.images.hint: Each picture becomes a file next to the Markdown file.
option.inline_images: Put the pictures inside the page
option.inline_images.hint: One file that can be moved or sent. Turn off to save the pictures as separate files.
editor.title: Editor
editor.help.edit-pdf: Add text, pictures, shapes and links, or cover and replace text. Pick a tool, then drag on the page. The original file is not changed.
editor.help.annotate: Highlight, underline, strike out, add notes or draw. Marks are saved as real PDF annotations.
editor.help.sign-pdf: Draw, type or choose a signature, then click where it goes. This is a picture of a signature, not a digital signature.
editor.help.fill-sign: Type into the form fields on the page, then place a signature, initials or a date.
editor.help.create-forms: Draw fields on the page, or find them from underlines and boxes. Fields can be filled in any PDF reader.
editor.found: {count, plural, one {# place for a field found} other {# places for fields found}}. Click one to add it.
editor.noneFound: No places for fields found on this page.
editor.chooseSignature: Make or choose a signature first, then click the page.
editor.noFormFields: This file has no form fields. You can still place a signature, initials or a date.
editor.placed: {count, plural, one {# item placed} other {# items placed}}
editor.filled: {count, plural, one {# field filled} other {# fields filled}}
editor.whiteoutHint: A patch covers what is under it in the saved file. The covered text is still inside the file; use Redact to remove it for good.
editor.position: Position in percent of the page
editor.sign.title: Signature
editor.sign.name: Name
editor.sign.pictureHint: Choose a picture of a signature or a stamp. A picture cannot be saved for later.
editor.sign.keepHint: Saved on this computer, protected so only your Windows account can read it.
editor.sign.ready: Ready. Click the page to place it.
editor.help.redact: Remove content for good. Draw areas on the pages, or enter words and patterns below to find text. What lies under an area is taken out of the file, not only covered.
editor.matches.found: {count, plural, one {# place found} other {# places found}}. They are shown on the pages with a dashed outline and will be removed.
editor.matches.none: No words or patterns found yet. Matches show here as you type.
option.redact.terms.hint: One on each line. Upper and lower case are the same unless you turn that on.
option.redact.patterns.hint: Regular expressions, one on each line, such as INV-\d{4}. A pattern that is not valid is reported before anything is changed.
option.redact.pages.hint: For example 1,3-5, even, odd or all. Areas you draw always apply to their own page.
option.redact.strip_metadata: Clear the document information and XMP metadata
choice.compare.mode.both: The text and the look of the pages
choice.compare.mode.visual: The look of the pages only
option.compare.tolerance_percent: How much a color may differ (percent)
option.compare.tolerance_percent.hint: Pixels that differ by less than this are not counted as changed. 2 ignores tiny shading differences.
option.compare.ignore_whitespace: Ignore spacing and blank lines in the text
option.compare.pages.hint: Page numbers are the same in both files, for example 1,3-5, even, odd or all. Add the original first, then the changed file.
option.compare.dpi.hint: 100 is enough to see changes. Use more to see very small ones.
option.digital-sign.pfx_path.hint: A .pfx or .p12 file with your certificate and its private key.
option.digital-sign.pfx_password.hint: Used once to open the file. It is never saved or shown.
option.digital-sign.visible: Show the signature on a page
option.digital-sign.visible.hint: Off signs invisibly: readers still show the signature in their signature panel.
option.digital-sign.left.hint: As a share of the page width, from 0 (left) to 1 (right).
option.digital-sign.top.hint: As a share of the page height, from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).
option.digital-sign.width.hint: As a share of the page width.
option.digital-sign.height.hint: As a share of the page height.
option.digital-sign.field.hint: The name of an empty signature field, for example one made with Create forms. Leave empty to add a new one.
option.digital-sign.signer_name.hint: Leave empty to use the name in the certificate.
choice.digital-sign.level.b-lt: Plus revocation answers, for checks without the internet later
choice.digital-sign.level.b-lta: Plus a time stamp over the whole file, for checks years later
option.digital-sign.timestamp_url.hint: The http or https address of a time stamp server (RFC 3161) that you trust.
option.digital-sign.allow_network.hint: The time stamp server and the certificate authorities are asked. Only hashes and certificate numbers are sent, never the document.
choice.digital-sign.certify.form-fill: Yes, and allow filling in forms
choice.digital-sign.certify.annotate: Yes, and allow forms and comments
option.verify-signatures.trusted_certifi: A file of certificates to trust besides those of Windows, for example the root certificate of your company.
option.verify-signatures.check_revocatio: Off uses only the answers stored in the file. On asks the certificate authorities named in the certificates.
option.verify-signatures.allow_network.h: Only certificate numbers and hashes of the issuers are sent, never the document.
certificates.none: No certificate with a private key was found in your personal certificate store.
certificates.hint: Certificates of your personal Windows store that can sign. Smart cards and tokens ask for their PIN.
